aircraftCfg._comment: Use the official AT76 designator only when Microsoft/S&H creator evidence and an explicitly non-freighter ATR 72-600 title are both present.

telemetry._comment: No ATR-specific LVAR is active. Microsoft/S&H do not publish an external variable contract with verified MSATR_* readback semantics, so the dedicated page uses standard SimConnect fields only.

controls._comment: Only the narrow standard gear/flaps fallback is available outside the dedicated monitoring page. No aircraft-specific control writes are mapped without a vendor-documented route and independent in-sim readback.

meta.notes: Dedicated monitoring-first page for the Microsoft / S&H Software Expert Series ATR 72-600 passenger aircraft. The profile and trusted adapter use standard SimConnect fields only; unverified aircraft-specific FGCP/AP readbacks and all custom cockpit writes remain unmapped.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Expert Series I: ATR 42-600 / 72-600
sources.notes: Confirms the official ATR 42-600 / 72-600 package, identifies the ATR 72-600 as part of the bundle, and publishes high-level ATR 72-600 characteristics including passenger role, crew size, and cruise/range figures.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update - week of June 1, 2026
sources.notes: Officially lists ATR 42-600 / 72-600 under First Party with creator Microsoft / S&H Software and availability for PC and Xbox.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator Support - Where can I find a manual?
sources.notes: The cited official support article does not define an ATR-specific custom-variable interface.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator Support - Controller Settings FAQ
sources.notes: Official MSFS 2024 support article documents aircraft-specific controller profiles and that nearly every mouse-manipulated cockpit function can be mapped in the simulator UI, but it does not expose ATR-specific external LVAR or SimConnect names.

sources.name: MSFS SDK documentation - Aircraft Editor Systems Tab / Local Vars
sources.notes: Official SDK documentation explains that L: local variables are aircraft-local variables accessed with the L: identifier in RPN and may be stored in state.cfg, but it does not publish ATR-specific MSATR_* semantics.

knownIssues: Microsoft and S&H do not publish an ATR 72-600-specific external telemetry or control interface in the cited sources.
Aircraft-specific telemetry remains absent from the active profile and adapter pending vendor documentation and in-sim verification.
The dedicated page is monitoring-only and its standard-SimVar fields still require validation against the supported native MSFS package.
ATR selected-speed telemetry remains on standard SimConnect because the cited vendor sources do not define an aircraft-specific readback with Flight Fabric-compatible units.
This profile intentionally matches the passenger ATR 72-600 only and does not attempt to cover the 72-600F freighter or the ATR 42 variants included in the same package.
MLW, MZFW, flap schedule, and gear speed schedule remain absent because the cited vendor sources do not confirm them.
